description: Synthetic OCR fixtures for novel-miner ticket 06+. L1 product rules use fake OcrEngine; these images support adapter contract tests, L2 multipart smoke, and L3 upload journeys. Includes tate-gaki, phone-tilt, brightness, and intra-shot mixed style suites.
font_note: Generated with IPAex/Noto CJK; font not required at test runtime.
